ns2:section.sectionText: For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration Instructor approval is required to register for the Statistics internship course. To obtain approval, internships must first be discussed with instructor David Dalpiaz to evaluate whether the internship is relevant, and determine the appropriate number of credit hours for the course. After instructor approval, the main office will assist with registration for the appropriate section of STAT 593. This course is restricted to statistics graduate students. Undergraduates in statistics must seek approval from advisor David Unger. After advisor approval, the main office will assist with registration for the appropriate section of STAT 593. This section is for 1 TO 8 CREDIT HOURS. Grading: Standard Letter.
